items.title: Seagate tops quarterly estimates and issues blockbuster first-quarter guidance
items.summary: Investing.com -- Seagate Technology PLC (NASDAQ:STX) shares surged 7.4% in after-hours trading Tuesday after the data storage giant posted fourth-quarter earnings and sales that comfortably topped Wall Street estimates and delivered an upbeat outlook for the upcoming fiscal year. The company posted adjusted fourth-quarter earnings of $5.71 per share on revenue of $3.6 billion, representing a 49% year-over-year top-line expansion from $2.4 billion in the prior-year period.
